instruction: Calculate the MELD score for patient S0674240 on date 2023-07-01. Retrieve the bilirubin (code: TBIL), INR (code: INR), and creatinine (code: CR) from the Observation resources for this patient on that date. Apply the MELD minimum-value correction: if any lab value is less than 1, replace it with 1 before computing MELD. Report the result as a JSON object.
context: Current date: 2023-07-01. The MELD formula is: MELD = 3.78 * ln(bilirubin) + 11.2 * ln(INR) + 9.57 * ln(creatinine) + 6.43. Important: before computing MELD, if bilirubin < 1, use 1; if INR < 1, use 1; if creatinine < 1, use 1. The lab codes in this dataset are: TBIL for total bilirubin, INR for international normalized ratio, CR for serum creatinine. All three labs must be identified on the specified date. Return ONLY the JSON object — no extra text.
